title: 菊花賞の後に・絆の勝利！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek takes the Kikuka crown and rushes back to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We bask in the glory of a victory earned through the power of our bond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Leaving behind the Classics that taught us so much, we set our sights on the Nakayama racecourse winter race—the Arima Kinen!
